Captain **Haaland** (5.33 xP this GW, BOU (H)) — the single highest expected haul once the armband doubles it.
Builds around **Haaland** (£15.5m, BOU (H)) and **B.Fernandes** (£12.0m, HUL (A)) — their projected returns over the next 5 GWs justify the spend.

Leans into soft fixture runs — B.Fernandes (HUL, IPS, EVE, MCI, FUL), Virgil (NEW, NFO, IPS, FUL, BOU), Raya (COV, AVL, CHE, SUN, BHA) — where the opponent strength model rates the matchups easy over the next 5 GWs.
